_note: Requirements are inferred from the form's observed behavior and labels (no Stord spec is available). Each is covered by scenarios tagged with its ID, e.g. @REQ-GS-02. 'uat' is a manual business sign-off: automation never sets it. Statuses: Pending | Accepted | Rejected.

requirements.title: The form presents all contact and qualification fields with guidance placeholders
acceptanceCriteria: First name, last name, company, work email, phone, country, service and monthly order volume are displayed
The Let's Talk submit button is displayed
Each text field shows its guidance placeholder

requirements.title: First name, last name, company and work email are required
acceptanceCriteria: Leaving first name, last name, company or work email empty shows '* Required field'
The message clears once a valid value is entered
Submission cannot proceed while any one of them is missing

requirements.title: Phone number is optional
acceptanceCriteria: Leaving phone empty shows no error

requirements.title: Country, service and order volume selections are displayed and retained
acceptanceCriteria: A chosen option is shown in the dropdown and stored in its form value
Values already entered in other fields are kept after selecting

requirements.title: Dropdowns offer the approved business option lists
acceptanceCriteria: Service offers exactly: Warehousing, Software, Freight, Fulfillment, All Of The Above
Monthly order volume offers exactly six ranges, from 200,000+ down to Less Than 10,000
Country lists United States, Canada and United Kingdom first

requirements.title: Submission is gated until every required field is complete
acceptanceCriteria: The submit button is disabled on an empty form
It is enabled once all seven required fields are complete
It stays disabled when any single required field is missing

requirements.title: Free consumer email domains (gmail, yahoo, hotmail) are rejected; business domains are accepted
acceptanceCriteria: A gmail, yahoo or hotmail address keeps the submit button disabled
A business address (example.com, acme-logistics.com, mail.example.co.uk) enables it

requirements.title: A visitor can leave the form and return to the home page
acceptanceCriteria: The close (X) button is displayed
Clicking it navigates to the Stord home page

requirements.title: Entered data is retained exactly as typed (unicode, symbols, long input)
acceptanceCriteria: Apostrophes, accented and CJK text, symbols and markup-like text are kept unchanged
300-character and 1000-character entries are kept in full

requirements.title: The form meets WCAG 2.1 A/AA apart from documented known issues
acceptanceCriteria: An automated scan (axe) finds no rule outside the documented known issues
No known issue affects more elements than recorded

requirements.title: A post can be retrieved with the full field contract
acceptanceCriteria: GET a post returns 200 with id, userId, title and body of the correct types

requirements.title: A missing post returns a clean 404
acceptanceCriteria: GET a post that does not exist returns 404

requirements.title: Posts can be filtered by user without leaking other users' data
acceptanceCriteria: Filtering by user returns 200 and only that user's posts, and is never empty

requirements.title: A post can be created and the payload is echoed with a 201
acceptanceCriteria: POST a post returns 201 and echoes the submitted title, body and user
